import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from datetime import datetime

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    dim_account = inputs["dim_account"].copy()
    stg_account = inputs["stg_account"].copy()
    
    # Ensure proper data types
    dim_account["account_id"] = dim_account["account_id"].astype("int64")
    dim_account["is_current"] = dim_account["is_current"].astype("int64")
    stg_account["account_id"] = stg_account["account_id"].astype("int64")
    
    # Sort staging by account_id, update_date
    stg_account = stg_account.sort_values(["account_id", "update_date"]).reset_index(drop=True)
    
    # Process each staged record
    for idx, staged_row in stg_account.iterrows():
        s_account_id = staged_row["account_id"]
        s_plan = staged_row["plan"]
        s_update_date = pd.Timestamp(staged_row["update_date"])
        
        # Get all versions of this account
        account_versions = dim_account[dim_account["account_id"] == s_account_id].copy()
        
        if len(account_versions) == 0:
            # Account has no version yet, insert new version
            new_row = pd.DataFrame({
                "account_id": [s_account_id],
                "plan": [s_plan],
                "eff_start_date": [s_update_date],
                "eff_end_date": [pd.NaT],
                "is_current": [1]
            })
            dim_account = pd.concat([dim_account, new_row], ignore_index=True)
        else:
            # Find the version that covers s_update_date
            # A version covers a date if eff_start_date <= date < eff_end_date
            # (NULL eff_end_date means open-ended)
            covering_version = None
            covering_idx = None
            
            for vidx, version in account_versions.iterrows():
                v_start = pd.Timestamp(version["eff_start_date"])
                v_end = version["eff_end_date"]
                
                if pd.isna(v_end):
                    v_end = pd.Timestamp.max
                else:
                    v_end = pd.Timestamp(v_end)
                
                if v_start <= s_update_date < v_end:
                    covering_version = version.copy()
                    covering_idx = vidx
                    break
            
            if covering_version is None:
                # s_update_date is earlier than all versions
                # Find earliest version
                earliest_version_idx = account_versions["eff_start_date"].idxmin()
                earliest_version = dim_account.loc[earliest_version_idx]
                f_eff_start = pd.Timestamp(earliest_version["eff_start_date"])
                
                new_row = pd.DataFrame({
                    "account_id": [s_account_id],
                    "plan": [s_plan],
                    "eff_start_date": [s_update_date],
                    "eff_end_date": [f_eff_start],
                    "is_current": [0]
                })
                dim_account = pd.concat([dim_account, new_row], ignore_index=True)
            else:
                # Check if plan is the same
                v_plan = covering_version["plan"]
                plans_equal = (pd.isna(v_plan) and pd.isna(s_plan)) or (v_plan == s_plan)
                
                if plans_equal:
                    # No-op
                    pass
                elif s_update_date == pd.Timestamp(covering_version["eff_start_date"]):
                    # Same-day correction, update plan in place
                    dim_account.loc[covering_idx, "plan"] = s_plan
                else:
                    # Split the version
                    v_eff_end = covering_version["eff_end_date"]
                    v_is_current = covering_version["is_current"]
                    
                    # Insert new version for s_plan
                    new_row = pd.DataFrame({
                        "account_id": [s_account_id],
                        "plan": [s_plan],
                        "eff_start_date": [s_update_date],
                        "eff_end_date": [v_eff_end],
                        "is_current": [v_is_current]
                    })
                    dim_account = pd.concat([dim_account, new_row], ignore_index=True)
                    
                    # Update original version
                    dim_account.loc[covering_idx, "eff_end_date"] = s_update_date
                    dim_account.loc[covering_idx, "is_current"] = 0
    
    # Ensure proper column order and types
    dim_account_out = dim_account[[
        "account_id", "plan", "eff_start_date", "eff_end_date", "is_current"
    ]].reset_index(drop=True)
    
    dim_account_out["account_id"] = dim_account_out["account_id"].astype("int64")
    dim_account_out["is_current"] = dim_account_out["is_current"].astype("int64")
    dim_account_out["eff_start_date"] = pd.to_datetime(dim_account_out["eff_start_date"])
    dim_account_out["eff_end_date"] = pd.to_datetime(dim_account_out["eff_end_date"])
    
    return {"dim_account_out": dim_account_out}
